name: codex-enhancer
description: Proof of concept that loads an external runtime into a test copy of Codex Desktop and mounts an extension page in the official window.

scripts.detect: npm run build --silent && node dist/bin/codex-enhancer.js detect
scripts.install: if [ "${npm_command:-}" = run-script ]; then npm run build --silent && node dist/bin/codex-enhancer.js install; fi
scripts.uninstall: npm run build --silent && node dist/bin/codex-enhancer.js uninstall
scripts.status: npm run build --silent && node dist/bin/codex-enhancer.js status
scripts.launch: npm run build --silent && node dist/bin/codex-enhancer.js launch
scripts.lint: biome check --error-on-warnings . && npm run --silent lint:vue && node scripts/check-comments.mjs
scripts.test: ([ -f release.json ] || npm run build --silent) && node --test dist/compat/*.test.js dist/extensions/session-board/*.test.js dist/installer/*.test.js dist/migration/*.test.js dist/runtime/*.test.js
